name: asterisk
title: Asterisk
description: Hand-drawn footnote marks: an asterisk, a star, a dagger or a double dagger, in red pencil, sized like a superscript after the word they belong to. Give it a label and an href and it links to the footnote.

a11y: Decorative by default (aria-hidden). With `label` it is role="img" with that name; with `label` and `href` it is a real link (its hit area is 24 px or more).
A footnote mark points at a footnote: keep the footnote in text, and link the two (`href="#fn1"` here and an id on the note).
Sized in em, so it follows the text it sits in. Kept in Windows high contrast as a drawn glyph.
